notes.title: Laser Slide – A high-speed test of skill & reflexes!
notes.content:
Darkpeel’s lair has been discovered—but escaping won’t be easy. Lasers, traps, and high-speed slides stand between you and freedom. Do you have what it takes to survive?

* New Level – Laser Slide! A fusion of Laser Tracer’s dodging and Slide levels’ speed for non-stop action.

* Race Through Darkpeel’s Lair! A cinematic comic-book setting filled with deadly obstacles.

* Ever-Changing Challenge! Laser sections shift every round, keeping each match unpredictable.

* Speed, Skill & Survival! Dodge, jump, and slide to escape the villain’s ultimate trap!

notes.title: Hop into Easter! Limited-time events, rewards & discounts! 🐰
notes.content:
Get ready for a cracked-up Easter celebration in Stumble Guys! With special events, awesome rewards, and seasonal surprises, there’s no better time to stumble your way to victory!

* Play limited-time Easter events and win festive rewards!
* Unlock the Eggshell Knight, the ultimate seasonal prize!
* Grab your favorite egg & bunny skins before they’re gone!
* Enjoy 20-30% discounts on select items in the store!

Time is ticking! Don’t miss out on the Easter madness — jump in now!

notes.title: Graffiti Gravity: New Elimination Level & Surviving Chaos!
notes.content:
Get ready for the new Graffiti Gravity event!

* New Level: Dodge falling hazards atop a colorful building and avoid the holes they leave behind.
* New Mechanics: The floor regenerates, but the challenge only intensifies as the game progresses.
* Increasing Difficulty: As the level goes on, the falling hazards become faster and the patterns harder to predict.
* Survive the Madness: Stay on your feet and be the last one standing to win!

Can you survive the ever-growing chaos?

notes.title: Stumble into Looney Tunes chaos!
notes.content:
The Looney Tunes have stumbled into Stumble Guys, bringing chaos to the game like never before!

As the ACME factory goes haywire, the tunes are ready to bring the madness. Join Bugs, Taz, Daffy, and others as they race through the wild new Factory Fiasco map. Will you survive the mayhem?

* New Looney Tunes Skins! Play as your favorite toons in cowboy and ninja outfits.
* Factory Fiasco Map! Navigate through ACME-fueled chaos with dynamic obstacles.
* ACME Mayhem! The space shrinks, the challenges grow—only the swift survive!

Get ready for Looney chaos in Stumble Guys!

notes.title: GOAT Event Week: The Ultimate Celebration!
notes.content:
✨ It’s GOAT Event Week! Celebrate everything that makes Stumble Guys the GOAT with a full week of epic gameplay and creator takeovers!

Here’s what’s waiting for you:

🗺️ Epic Maps: Play the most iconic and thrilling courses ever.
🕺 Legendary Emotes: Show off with the most coveted moves.
🎥 Daily Creator Takeovers: Watch top content creators highlight their favorites and challenge you to join the fun.

Why join the fun?

* Experience Stumble Guys at its absolute best.
* Play fan-favorite maps that have become instant classics.
* Unlock exclusive, creator-inspired rewards and offers.

Whether you’re a Stumble Guys pro or new to the chaos, this is your chance to dive into greatness and celebrate the GOAT of all weeks! Don’t miss the fun and creator highlights—start stumbling now! 🎮🎉

notes.title: Capture Flags in Rocket Doom!
notes.content:
Rocket Doom brings fresh action to Stumble Guys! In this 4v4 mode, it's all about capturing flags, blasting rivals, and earning rewards.

* 4v4 Mode: Team up to capture flags and outplay your enemies.

* Flag Capturing: Fast-paced gameplay that tests your reflexes and strategy.

* Blasting Rivals: Send opponents flying across the map in explosive moments.

* Exclusive Rewards: Unlock rewards through different events, missions and leaderboards!

Get ready for a mix of competition and fun in Rocket Doom, where teamwork and chaos lead to victory!

notes.title: Banana Bonanza: Collect Statues & Score Epic Rewards!
notes.content:
Step into the new Banana Bonanza, a dynamic way to play and earn in Stumble Guys! With Banana Bonanza, players can now collect statues and redeem them for bigger and better rewards every time they play.

Here’s how Banana Bonanza works:

- Collect Statues: Gather collectible statues in each round as you play.
- Redeem & Earn: Redeem your collected statues for special rewards, including gems, skins, and more.
- Repeat for More Rewards: With every round, the chance to collect and earn continues, so keep playing to maximize your prizes.
Look out for special events with bonus LTC! Some events offer even more chances to collect, making them the perfect opportunity to score big. Jump into Banana Bonanza today and discover a fun, rewarding way to play Stumble Guys. Free gifts, epic rewards, and more await you!
